_note: The border-free area. The one real difference from the EU in this roster is CHE, which is in Schengen and was never in the EU -- GBR is in neither. Ships zero-priced for the reason eurozone.json gives: an open-borders effect (a trade bonus is the obvious candidate) is a measured band or nothing, and nothing is what is measured so far. The accession and withdrawal positions are MEASURED, not felt: Referendum.yes_share() was swept over the two-axis grid at a neutral-approval new-game, and every authored question sits 0.010-0.023 above the strict majority at rest -- winnable by a president the country does not hate, losable by one it does (INCUMBENT_SWING moves both ways), because a membership vote no electorate could ever pass is not a fight, it is a locked door. V3.3: seventeen of the nineteen joined; IRL is the opt-out and CYP has not yet been admitted, and both exclusions are the roster rather than an omission. V4.11: NOR and ISL join -- Schengen members through their association agreements while outside the EU, CHE's shape twice more.
name: Schengen
summary: The countries with no internal border controls. People, lorries and holiday traffic cross the lines without stopping.
